purpose: Source-level check for registered human trials of uPAR-directed / senolytic CAR-T for senescence or aging.
calibration_note: API verified functional: 'senolytic' returns 31 studies (all small-molecule senolytics: fisetin, dasatinib+quercetin, navitoclax-type, in OA/PAD/pulmonary/vascular aging contexts, none CAR-T); 'senescent cell CAR T' returns 72 studies, all oncology CAR-T (B-ALL, myeloma, AML), none senolytic/anti-aging and none uPAR-directed.
conclusion: As of 2026-10-18, NO registered ClinicalTrials.gov study targets uPAR/PLAUR with a senolytic CAR-T, and no senolytic CAR-T trial of any antigen was found. Human translation of the anti-uPAR senolytic strategy remains preclinical. (An anti-uPAR CAR-T oncology program from the same groups may enter trials but was not retrievable under these senescence/senolytic query terms on this date.)
limitation: Free-text term matching; a trial using alternate nomenclature (e.g., a sponsor code name, 'CAR-T senescence', or a company-specific construct name) could be missed. This is a documented negative under the stated queries/date, not proof of universal absence.
